title: Procyanidin B2 ameliorates hypoxic-ischemic brain damage in neonatal rats by inhibiting pyroptosis via the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Ting; Fang, Fang; Deng, Zhiyue; Xie, Lili; Song, Mengying; He, Qi; Chen, Sai; Wang, Shan; Feng, Qin; Fang, Chengzhi; Zhang, Binghong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PCB2通过TLR4/NF-kB通路抑制焦亡改善新生鼠缺氧缺血脑损伤，核心为小分子-蛋白互作与神经炎症，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) is a major cause of neonatal death and long-term neurodevelopmental impairment. Secondary neuroinflammation and inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis substantially contribute to progressive brain injury. Procyanidin B2 (PCB2), a plant-derived proanthocyanidin abundant in several traditional botanicals, exhibits anti-inflammatory activity, but its role in neonatal hypoxic-ischemic brain injury remains unclear. OBJECTIVE: To determine whether PCB2 protects against neonatal hypoxic-ischemic brain damage (HIBD) in rat and to clarify whether the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway-driven pyroptosis is involved. METHODS: A Rice-Vannucci hypoxic-ischemic brain injury model was established in postnatal day 7 Sprague-Dawley rats. Brain injury was assessed by H&E, Nissl staining, ultrastructural analysis, and long-term behavioral tests at P28. Transcriptomic profiling and enrichment analyses were used to identify key pathways. qRT-PCR, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence were performed to evaluate TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling and pyroptosis markers. TLR4 gain- and loss-of-function experiments were conducted in OGD-injured BV2 microglial cells. Molecular docking was applied to predict the potential PCB2-TLR4 interaction. RESULTS: PCB2 markedly reduced histopathological damage and improved P28 cognitive performance, accompanied by restoration of synaptic/neuronal markers. Transcriptomics identified enrichment of Toll-like receptor and cytokine-related inflammatory pathways among PCB2-reversed genes. PCB2 suppressed TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB activation and decreased NLRP3 inflammasome/pyroptosis proteins (NLRP3, ASC, caspase-1, GSDMD-N) and IL-1beta/IL-18 (all P < 0.05). TLR4 overexpression attenuated, whereas TLR4 silencing enhanced, PCB2's anti-pyroptotic effects in vitro. Molecular docking predicted a potential interaction between PCB2 and TLR4. CONCLUSIONS: PCB2 alleviates neonatal hypoxic-ischemic brain injury by inhibiting TLR4/NF-kappaB-dependent pyroptosis, supporting its potential as a therapeutic candidate for neonatal HIBD.
abstract_zh: 背景：新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）是新生儿死亡和长期神经发育障碍的主要原因。继发性神经炎症和炎症小体介导的焦亡显著促进进行性脑损伤。原花青素B2（PCB2）是一种植物来源的原花青素，富含于多种传统植物药中，具有抗炎活性，但其在新生儿缺氧缺血性脑损伤中的作用尚不清楚。目的：确定PCB2是否对大鼠新生儿缺氧缺血性脑损伤（HIBD）具有保护作用，并阐明TLR4/NF-kappaB通路驱动的焦亡是否参与其中。方法：在出生后第7天Sprague-Dawley大鼠中建立Rice-Vannucci缺氧缺血性脑损伤模型。通过H&E染色、尼氏染色、超微结构分析及P28长期行为学测试评估脑损伤。利用转录组学谱和富集分析识别关键通路。采用qRT-PCR、Western blotting和免疫荧光评估TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号及焦亡标志物。在OGD损伤的BV2小胶质细胞中进行TLR4功能获得和功能丧失实验。应用分子对接预测PCB2与TLR4的潜在相互作用。结果：PCB2显著减轻组织病理学损伤并改善P28认知表现，伴随突触/神经元标志物的恢复。转录组学识别出PCB2逆转基因中Toll样受体和细胞因子相关炎症通路的富集。PCB2抑制TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB激活，并降低NLRP3炎症小体/焦亡蛋白（NLRP3、ASC、caspase-1、GSDMD-N）及IL-1beta/IL-18水平（均P < 0.05）。TLR4过表达减弱，而TLR4沉默增强PCB2在体外的抗焦亡效应。分子对接预测PCB2与TLR4之间存在潜在相互作用。结论：PCB2通过抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB依赖性焦亡减轻新生儿缺氧缺血性脑损伤，支持其作为新生儿HIBD治疗候选药物的潜力。
